sources.title: See each claim; this file's claims carry their own sources.

note: Claims for polities the boundary source does not name in any year, so there is nothing to carry from a neighbouring snapshot and an extent has to be stated.

claims.note: Majapahit from Trowulan in eastern Java. The source draws Kediri over Trowulan at 1300 and 1400 -- Kediri was conquered in 1293 -- and Malaysian Islamic states at 1492 and 1500. The wider thalassocracy across the archipelago is disputed in the scholarship and is not drawn.
Singhasari held the same Javanese ground between Kediri and Majapahit. The source draws Kediri over it at 1279, fifty-seven years after Kediri fell.
